kind: the source read, the named ref, and the adjudication
whatThisCheckpointIs: This lane designs a surface that is NOT BUILT, so there is no delta to measure board by board against a shipped screen. What there IS to measure is the shipped product's own account of the surface - the stub it renders and the register row behind it - and the second dispatch item, which is an adjudication rather than a design. Both are below, at a named ref, before any board was drawn.

The design was dumped at origin/main, not at 96fdafbb, because the completion gate the row is graded on reads origin/main too: a design anchored to a ref the gate does not read is a design about a product that is not shipping.

theStubVerbatim.h2: City document search is not built on this product.
theStubVerbatim.body: Document search stays a named island on the live city until a records-search lens is designed. The top-bar search box is disabled for the same reason, so the chrome and this page say the same thing.
theStubVerbatim.basis: Basis: no records-search view designed. Named on Connections as an island, not as a home that exists.

theRegisterRowsBehindIt.row113: { table: "primary", job: "Prophecy document search", home: "Work Records search", disposition: "Not built" }
theRegisterRowsBehindIt.row119: { table: "review-product", job: "City document table", home: "Files", disposition: "Island" }
theRegisterRowsBehindIt.whatTheRowsSay: two rows, one job each. The v1 capability this replaces was a DOCUMENT SEARCH and it is recorded NOT BUILT - not empty. The document table that stands in for it is an ISLAND, named, until a lens is designed for it. That lens is this folder.

theStubWasCheckedAgainstTheRegisterRathe.theQuery: the stub's basis sentence says the island is 'Named on Connections'. The register says row 119's home is "Files", so the two appeared to name different surfaces and this looked like a shipped inconsistency worth reporting.
theStubWasCheckedAgainstTheRegisterRathe.theRead: it is not an inconsistency. The register is the HOMES TABLE, and the Homes table renders on the Connections surface - `scripts/bake-connections.mjs` bakes it, and src/server.test.mjs:304 asserts the Connections page carries 'from N Homes-table rows'. The `table` field is a COLUMN of the Connections-rendered table (primary / review-product / products), not a different surface.
theStubWasCheckedAgainstTheRegisterRathe.so: the stub and the register agree. Recorded because the check was run and the finding was negative - a lane that only reports the findings that landed has not shown it looked.

theRegisterRowsBehindIt.theRegisterEarnedItsAuthorityByBeingWron: the dispatch quotes the comment block at :71 - four surfaces said 'Not built' while their tabs shipped and rendered 72 generated records between them. So this design treats the register as the authority AND treats a contradiction of it as a source read rather than an opinion. This lane found NO contradiction: the stub, the register and the lens-claims test all say the same thing about Records search, which is that no view exists.
